properties.description: Carga inicial de pilotos desde silver.drivers a gold.dim_driver. Supone nombres originales de columnas Ergast en Silver. driver_sk es IDENTITY. Validar Source y Sink en ADF.

scriptLines: query: 'SELECT TRY_CONVERT(int, d.driverId) AS driver_id, LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(NULLIF(d.driverRef, \'\\N\'), \'Unknown\'))), 60) AS driver_ref, TRY_CONVERT(smallint, NULLIF(NULLIF(CAST(d.[number] AS varchar(30)), \'\\N\'), \'\')) AS permanent_number, LEFT(NULLIF(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.code)), \'\\N\'), \'\'), 3) AS driver_code, LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.forename)), 60) AS forename, LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.surname)), 60) AS surname, LEFT(CONCAT(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.forename)), \' \', LTRIM(RTRIM(d.surname))), 125) AS full_name, TRY_CONVERT(date, NULLIF(NULLIF(CAST(d.dob AS varchar(30)), \'\\N\'), \'\')) AS dob, LEFT(COALESCE(NULLIF(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.nationality)), \'\\N\'), \'\'), \'Unknown\'), 60) AS nationality FROM silver.drivers d WHERE TRY_CONVERT(int, d.driverId) IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.forename)), \'\') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.surname)), \'\') IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gold.dim_driver g WHERE g.driver_id = TRY_CONVERT(int, d.driverId))',
